'''Tyrus''' was [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] of the mercenary strike force [[Crimson Aces]], second-in-command to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gikkin]]. Tyrus took over the position of commander after Gikkin's death.
